record.rationale: Browser composition binds the pinned i18npool and NumberText implementation names and services to their actual linked constructors. UNO context and service lookup remain with the original CPPU owners. Production desktop static registration binds the exact stocservices.component TypeConverter implementation/service names and actual constructor export. Both main.tsx and calc-ods-worker.ts already install this registry through InitApplicationServiceManager. Genuine process context/ServiceManager/Converter.create/PropertyValueSet execution now covers successful conversions, original caches, direct typed failures and first-versus-repeat failed-read wasNull behavior. The real Chromium main and DOM-free module Worker probe runs this same production registry alongside the native DOM graph. No fake positive context, manager, converter, factory or property provider is supplied. Full type-manager/named enum QA, efficient XPropertyAccess, native ABI/threads, resolver/DocumentBuilder/metadata and DOCX/XLSX/UI remain unfinished. JavaScript exception ABI explicitly links existing generated constructors and lazy native type getters; borrowed declared storage is copied by the actual generated class. Zero-argument getCaughtException uses synchronous host catch scope, with nesting restored. Original source misc catch/throw assertions pass; physical C++ binary mappings, machine code and native TLS are not certified. Actual UCB Any cancellation, CommandFailedException, Content isDocument/openStream and registered native CDocumentBuilder retain original defaults, callbacks and stream ownership. Original domtest stream QA passes. Real UCB/SimpleFileAccess providers, URI success/fallback service QA, metadata and full DOCX/XLSX shell/UI acceptance remain unfinished. Original complete CXPathAPI/CXPathObject/CNodeList owners use the pinned native libxml2 XPath engine, generated SDK contracts, actual document identity and shared native result lifetime. Namespace insertion is first-wins, evaluation copies namespace/extension references and global generic-error reset remains at its original source location. Source domtest testXXPathAPI/testXXPathObject assertions run through the production context/service manager; actual Chromium main and DOM-free Worker evaluate/count/select with identical native root identity. Compiler-generated C accessors and bounded varargs formatting expose actual native fields, not guessed layouts or an alternate XPath evaluator. Shared-pointer control-block and synchronous mutex execution are explicit language lowering. Native allocation-failure/undefined inputs/float-to-integer overflow, successful custom extension results, native shared-memory concurrency, real URI providers, metadata and full DOCX/XLSX shell/UI remain unqualified.
